instruction: Add a keyboard shortcut "ctrl+`" to toggle the terminal panel in VS Code when the editor has focus.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a VSCode keyboard shortcut ctrl+` to toggle the terminal when editor has focus. Uses existing check_json_keybindings function to verify the keybinding with conditional 'when' clause is correctly added to keybindings.json.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all instruction requirements: key binding (ctrl+`), command (workbench.action.terminal.toggleTerminal), and when-clause (editorFocus)

Data flow is correct: get_vm_file fetches keybindings.json from VM and returns cached file path, check_json_keybindings reads this file and verifies the expected keybinding dict exists in the JSON array
Expected values are semantically correct for VSCode keybinding configuration
Metric logic properly handles JSON parsing with fallback for files with comment headers (skip_first_line_load_json)
Complete coverage: all three aspects of the keybinding (key, command, when-clause) are verified
